title: bidens macroptera
intro: Bidens macroptera, commonly known as Bidens, is a plant species native to tropical Asia, particularly in India and Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, pain relief, and antipyretic (fever-reducing) effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Bidens macroptera plant have shown potential in protecting against oxidative stress and inflammation, and may also possess antiviral and antibacterial activities.
